card.name: Punctuation in tech article bylines
card.fires_on: Digits, spaces and hyphens inside timestamps, article IDs and tech-term compounds (RAID-0, High-Availability) in computer-hardware and IT web articles. Strongest in a byline with a date and time such as '12:00 PM EST - Posted in'.

modes.label: Timestamp pieces
modes.description: Digits, spaces or the zone in a date and time line of a hardware review byline.

modes.description: Hyphen inside storage or IT product terms such as RAID-0.

modes.label: Article ID or contact line
modes.description: Space before an ID number, or a word in an author contact line.

card.writes: It nudges output toward galaxy, sci-fi and gaming words like Galaxy, Galactic and overclock, though the link to the contexts is weak.
card.plain: It lights up on small punctuation and number pieces in computer-magazine bylines, dates and hardware names.
